title: PageGuide Gemini
description: A Chrome extension that connects Gemini citations to evidence on the page. Jump to an existing source tab, highlight quoted text, or draw labeled boxes over images and charts.
bannerAlt: PageGuide Gemini highlighting cited evidence alongside a Gemini answer

title: PhongKham AI
description: A Vietnamese clinic assistant for booking and canceling appointments, answering clinic FAQs, and exploring synthetic clinic data with a pandas-based analytics agent.
bannerAlt: Clinic booking, medical chat, and appointment calendar illustration

title: DealMesh
description: A shopping-list optimizer that compares combinations of products, sellers, shipping costs, and bundle discounts across marketplaces, with an explanation for each choice.
bannerAlt: DealMesh ecommerce concept with product cards and an optimizer comparing seller bundles, shipping costs, and savings

title: MuseLive
description: A live educational streaming platform where teachers broadcast lessons and viewers join live chat and quizzes, follow creators, and discover new streams.
bannerAlt: MuseLive streaming website concept with a live lesson, interactive quiz, lesson chat, and teacher discovery

title: PaperSwipe
description: A mobile app for discovering academic papers matched to your research interests. Swipe to save or dismiss papers, then search and filter your saved reading list.
bannerAlt: Academic paper discovery and swipe cards illustration

title: Shotcard
description: A macOS tool that turns screenshots of Japanese text or images into level-aware explanations and Anki flashcards, with furigana, audio, and optional Obsidian notes.

title: HoT: Highlighted Chain of Thought
description: A method for referencing supporting facts from inputs by highlighting evidence directly in the source text.

title: Argue.ai: Mutli-LLM Debate
description: Let 2 LLMs talk to each other to brainstorm and generate better solutions.

title: Statistics in HCI
description: A collection of references and notes on the statistical methods commonly used in HCI research.
